lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Good day, Tenerife — you're listening to Radio Tenerify, and it is a gorgeous Wednesday out there.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: It really is! Clear skies, twenty-two degrees down in the south — classic summer perfection. Not too hot, just right.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Before we get into the fun stuff, we do want to briefly acknowledge a story that's been circulating — a British man lost his life following a fight in the Las Verónicas area back in late May. A sad reminder to look out for each other on a night out.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Absolutely. Stay safe out there, everyone. Now — on a much brighter note, Santa Cruz has a brilliant few days coming up!

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Yes! This Saturday, the Urban Beach Festival lands at the Puerto de Santa Cruz, with Beéle bringing his Borondo Tour to the island. Should be a fantastic night.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: And then Sunday, urban reggaeton artist Kapo makes his very first Tenerife appearance over at the Palmetum car park. First time on the island — that's a big deal!

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Check the webtenerife website for tickets on both. It's a great weekend to be here.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: It really is. Enjoy that sunshine, Tenerife — we'll see you soon!
